title: REQ-053 garden-plan geometry vectors (shared Backend <-> Frontend test vectors)
spec: spec/req/REQ-053_Grafische-Garten-Beetplanung.md v1.4 - §9.2, §19.6, §20.1, §22.2 (V-01..V-06), GP-ACC-003/004, GP-ACC-017/018/043 (layout), GP-FR-160/GP-ACC-053 (site_fit), GP-FR-044 (place_geometry), GP-UX-047/GP-FR-003 (label_anchor), GP-FR-166 (reach), GP-FR-123 (area_dose, nitrogen_approximation, unit_identity), GP-FR-167 (edge_distance, nearest_water_source)
description: Single source of truth for the shared geometry logic (REQ-053 §19.6).
The Python reference is src/backend/app/domain/calculators/geometry_calculator.py together with
runs against this same file. One test per side reads the file - a test that copies these cases inline
Every case has: id (stable, never reused), operation, spec (the rule it pins), input, expected and an optional
tolerance (absolute, in the unit of the expected value; default_tolerance applies when omitted).
Booleans and string lists are compared exactly; numbers and number lists within the tolerance.
conventions: anchor: rect.origin (lower-left corner before rotation), circle/point.origin (centre), first vertex of polygon/polyline.
rotation pivots about the anchor; p_plan = anchor + R(rotation_deg) * p_bed (§9.2).

local (bed) frame: anchor at (0,0), no rotation - slots are expressed in the bed frame of their location. Because the anchor of a circular bed is its centre (and of a polygon bed its first vertex), slot coordinates are legitimately negative; the bed frame therefore accepts -1000 <= x,y <= 1000 (placeholder until the spec fixes the range - see the needs-decision issue linked from #2321), the plan frame 0 <= x,y <= 1000 (V-01).

rounding: the exact binary value is rounded to 3 decimals with ties away from zero - Python Decimal(value).quantize(Decimal('0.001'), ROUND_HALF_UP), TypeScript Number(value.toFixed(3)). Not Math.round(x*1000)/1000 and not Python's built-in round() (ties to even). -0.0 is stored as 0.0. rotation_deg is range-checked on the input (0 <= r < 360); an input below 360 that rounds to 360.000 is stored as 0.0; a negative input is invalid.
V-01 field types are strict: a number is required, a string ('1.5') or boolean is invalid; an integer is accepted as a float.
area_m2, bbox and centroid are rounded to 0.001 m / m2 (GP-FR-004); predicates work on unrounded values.

bbox = [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] after rotation; a polyline's bbox includes its stroke (+- width_m / 2 on every side). Containment of a polyline uses its vertices only (V-03 wording), so a fence drawn on the boundary passes V-03 although its stroke sticks out - a deliberate asymmetry.
centroid: area centroid for rect/circle/polygon, vertex mean for polyline, the point itself for point; computed in the local frame and transformed afterwards.

contains(parent, child, tolerance_m = 0.01, inset_m = 0): every child vertex (the 4 transformed corners of a rotated rect) is at least inset_m - tolerance_m inside the parent; a circle child is checked by centre distance + radius; against a polygon parent every child edge is split at its meetings with parent edges and each piece's midpoint must be inside (a child edge through parent vertices into a concave notch is rejected); with an inset every parent vertex must keep inset_m - tolerance_m from every child edge (reflex corners). mode 'plan' resolves both geometries in the frame they are expressed in (V-03); mode 'bed' resolves the parent in its own local frame and the child as given (V-04, slot in bed frame; the child is then parsed with frame 'bed').

overlaps(a, b, tolerance_m = 0.01): true only when the shapes penetrate by more than tolerance_m - beds sharing an edge do not overlap. bbox pre-test, then separating-axis test for convex polygons (projection overlap > tolerance on every axis), for concave ones: a proper edge crossing with all four ends more than the tolerance from the other line, or a vertex more than the tolerance inside the other, or an inward probe at tolerance/2 behind an edge midpoint that is at least tolerance/2 inside the other shape (identical and coincident-edge shapes). Both tests give the same verdict for parallel edges and corner penetration. Circles by distance formulas. point and polyline never overlap anything.
is_simple (V-02): no two non-adjacent edges meet (a revisited vertex is a self-touch), no edge folds back onto its neighbour, no zero-length edge, area > 0. contains/overlaps assume V-02 passed.
validate_model (V-01): expected.valid; when valid and expected.normalized is present, parsing must yield exactly that; input.frame ('plan' default | 'bed') selects the coordinate range.
resolved_area: shoelace over the vertices of the resolved (rotated) shape, rounded to 0.001 - the proof that rotation preserves area along the port's own transform path.

layout (planting_layout_calculator.compute_layout, REQ-053 GP-FR-060/062): positions in the bed frame, rounded like every stored length. Rows run along the axis selected by entry.row_direction - along_length = the longer side of the bed-frame bounding box (tie: x), along_width = the shorter one; the first position sits edge_margin_along from the start of its row, the first row edge_margin_across from the side (defaults spacing / 2 and row_spacing / 2; 0 for a zone). A position is kept when the box of half-extents (margin_along, margin_across) around it lies inside the bed (inside the polygon and no boundary edge entering the box; four box corners inside the disc for a circle); a position may sit on the edge when both margins are 0. grid: row_spacing = spacing; triangular: row_spacing = spacing x 0.866 and every second row shifted by spacing / 2; rows: entry.row_spacing_cm (required); zone: one slot, capacity = floor(area / (spacing x row_spacing)); free: capacity estimate only. Counts are floored after adding 1e-6. The zone capacity of a circle uses the circle area. The pre-estimate floor(area / (spacing x row_spacing)) > 2000 is refused before any point exists (layout_error, estimated is exact) unless the entry has a row_assignment, which is bounded by the candidate walk and its real count; so is a bounding-box walk of more than 10 000 candidates and a result of more than 2000 positions. Warnings are compared by code, in order: layout.spacing_below_mature_width, planting.spacing_below_minimum (V-07), layout.no_position_fits, layout.zone_inset_not_applied.
layout_error: the same input as layout, expected {code, estimated?} - the 422 the Python reference raises as PlanError and the TypeScript port throws as LayoutError.

operations.overdue: input.now (ISO instant), input.due (ISO value | null) -> expected boolean: overdue when the UTC calendar day of due lies before the UTC calendar day of now - a task due today is never overdue, whatever the time of day (overdue_calculator.is_overdue / model/overdue.ts isOverdue, REQ-053 GP-FR-192, #2461)
operations.phase_color: input.name (growth-phase name as stored, growth_phases.name) -> expected "#RRGGBB": a name that is a known phase after lower-casing and dropping every character outside a-z takes its fixed colour; any other name takes FALLBACK_PALETTE[abs(h) % 10] with h = int32(h * 31 + c) over the UTF-16 code units c of the unnormalised name (phase_colors.phase_color / planting/phaseColors.ts phaseColor, REQ-053 GP-FR-067, GP-UX-005)
operations.place_geometry: input.geometry (bed template default_geometry in the bed frame: rect | circle | polygon), input.origin [x, y], input.rotation_deg -> expected the plan-frame geometry: the anchor (rect origin, circle centre, first polygon vertex) at origin, rotation_deg = (own + requested) folded into [0, 360) and rounded to 0.001; a circle carries no rotation (template_placement_calculator.place_geometry / templates/placeGeometry.ts placeGeometry, REQ-053 GP-FR-044, #2536)
operations.label_anchor: input.geometry (rect | circle | polygon | polyline | point, plan frame) -> expected {point: [x, y], width_m}: the centre of the object's horizontal label and the widest label centred there that stays inside the shape - rect/circle: centre (room = horizontal chord / diameter); polygon: pole of inaccessibility (polylabel quadtree to 0.01 m in the local frame, seeded with the area centroid, cells in the total order potential desc, x asc, y asc, insertion; start cell size max(shorter box side, longer box side / 64, 0.01), a cell is refined only while min(potential, shorter box side / 2) - best distance > 0.01; a non-finite vertex yields the first vertex), room = 2 x min(reach left, reach right) along the chord y = point_y (edges half-open in y); polyline: point at half its length, room = bbox width incl. stroke; point: the point, room 0. Rounded to 0.001 (label_anchor_calculator.label_anchor / model/labelAnchor.ts labelAnchor, REQ-053 GP-UX-047, GP-FR-003, #2490) - the PDF writer and the editor place names on this point
operations.label_truncate: input.text (an object name), input.max_chars (integer >= 1) -> expected string: whitespace runs collapse to one space; a name longer than max_chars is cut to max(1, max_chars - 1) characters, trailing spaces dropped, and "…" appended. Characters are Unicode code points (Python len), never UTF-16 code units: a character outside the BMP counts once and is never split (plan_svg_engine._truncate / model/labelAnchor.ts truncateLabel, REQ-053 GP-UX-047, GP-FR-003, #2490 SCR-004)
operations.reach: input.geometry (rect | circle | polygon | polyline | point, plan frame, or null), input.access_sides (list of N | E | S | W, or null), optional input.both_sides_m (default 1.2) and input.one_side_m (default 0.6) -> expected {hint, reason (too_wide | within_reach | width_unknown), access (both | one | unknown), threshold_m, width_m}: access is both when the list holds an opposite pair (N + S or E + W), one for any other non-empty list (two adjacent sides are one), unknown for an empty or missing list, which takes the one-side threshold; width = min(width_m, length_m) of a rect, the diameter of a circle, the minimum caliper width of a convex polygon (over all edges the largest vertex distance from the edge line), null for a concave polygon, a polyline, a point or no geometry; width rounded to 0.001 m, hint (bed.reach_too_wide) only when width > threshold, never an error - reach_calculator.assess / model/reach.ts assessReach (GP-FR-166, WP 8.23; thresholds confirmed O-17)
operations.area_dose: input.quantity (rate per m2 | null), input.unit (care unit | null), input.area_m2 (bed area | null) -> expected {quantity_total, quantity_total_unit, display_total}: for g_per_m2 / l_per_m2 the total is quantity x area_m2 rounded to 0.001 with unit g / l, display_total the same total in whole grams or litres to 0.1; any other unit, no quantity or area_m2 <= 0 or null -> all three null, never 0. Rounding half up on the exact binary value (area_dose_calculator.quantity_total, display_total / model/areaDose.ts areaDoseTotal, REQ-053 GP-FR-123, WP 8.9)
operations.nitrogen_approximation: input.rate_g_per_m2, input.n_percent (product N % on the label | null) -> expected {g_n_per_m2, kg_n_per_ha} | null: g N/m2 = rate x N % / 100 rounded to 0.1, kg N/ha = the unrounded g N/m2 x 10 rounded to whole kg; null when the rate is <= 0 or the N % is missing, <= 0 or > 100. An approximation of the product N, labelled as such; no threshold, no seasonal warning (R-004 open) (area_dose_calculator.nitrogen_approximation / model/areaDose.ts nitrogenApproximation, WP 8.9)
operations.unit_identity: input.value, input.unit (g_per_m2 | l_per_m2) -> expected {kg_per_ha} for g_per_m2 (1 g/m2 = 10 kg/ha) or {mm} for l_per_m2 (1 L/m2 = 1 mm layer), unrounded (area_dose_calculator.g_per_m2_to_kg_per_ha, l_per_m2_to_mm / model/areaDose.ts, review U-001, WP 8.9)
operations.edge_distance: input.a, input.b (rect | circle | polygon | polyline | point, plan frame) -> expected number (m): the shortest edge-to-edge distance between the two shapes, 0 when they touch, overlap or one contains the other (also a point inside an area). Rotation is applied about the anchor; a circle is exact (centre distance minus radius); a polyline counts with its stroke (a band of width_m around the centre line, round ends); a point is the point itself. Exact, no tolerance; rounded to 0.001 m like every stored length - geometry_distance.edge_distance_m / model/geometryDistance.ts edgeDistanceM (REQ-053 GP-FR-167, WP 9.12; the primitive GP-FR-130 path access consumes)
operations.nearest_water_source: input.bed (rect | circle | polygon, plan frame, or null), input.sources (list of water-source geometries, plan frame) -> expected number (m) | null: the smallest edge_distance from the bed to any source, rounded to 0.001 m; null without a bed geometry or without a source. Which objects are sources (object_type water_source, not off_site) is decided by the caller - geometry_distance.nearest_water_source_m / model/geometryDistance.ts nearestWaterSourceM (REQ-053 GP-FR-167, WP 9.12)
